title: On the Last-Iterate Convergence of Clipped Gradient Methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.21026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In stochastic (strongly) convex optimization, establishing last-iterate convergence guarantees for first-order methods has recently garnered increasing attention, as this not only deepens the theoretical understanding of these algorithms but also aligns more closely with practice. Notably, people have demonstrated that one of the most famous, simple, and popular methods, Stochastic Gradient Descent ($\mathtt{SGD}$), provably achieves last-iterate convergence. However, the existing results may have limited applicability, since they typically rely on strong conditions on the gradient noise (e.g., an exponentially decaying tail) rather than the more realistic heavy-tailed noise. Unfortunately, when faced with heavy-tailed noise, $\mathtt{SGD}$ is known to exhibit undesirable behavior or even fail to converge. translated_title: 论裁剪梯度方法的末次迭代收敛性
translated_abstract: 在随机（强）凸优化中，为一阶方法建立末次迭代收敛保证近来受到越来越多的关注，因为这不仅加深了对这些算法的理论理解，而且与实践更为贴近。值得注意的是，人们已经证明，最著名、简单且流行的随机梯度下降（SGD）方法能够可证明地实现末次迭代收敛。然而，现有结果的适用性可能有限，因为它们通常依赖于对梯度噪声的较强条件（例如指数衰减的尾部），而非更现实的重尾噪声。不幸的是，面对重尾噪声时，已知SGD会表现出不良行为甚至无法收敛。为应对重尾噪声的挑战，人们提出了Clipped-SGD，这是一种将……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对梯度噪声为重尾分布这一更贴近实际的情形，研究并证明了裁剪梯度方法（如Clipped-SGD）在随机（强）凸优化中的末次迭代收敛性，克服了现有SGD末次迭代收敛结果依赖强噪声条件（如指数衰减尾部）的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes last-iterate convergence guarantees for clipped gradient methods (e.g., Clipped-SGD) in stochastic (strongly) convex optimization under realistic heavy-tailed gradient noise, overcoming the strong noise assumptions (e.g., exponentially decaying tails) required by existing last-iterate convergence results for SGD.
